verdict.rationale: The evidence pack consistently frames Airbyte as an EL(T) tool that consolidates data from sources into warehouses/lakes/databases (e.g., airbyte-docs-32, airbyte-gh-1, airbyte-docs-24), with no documentation of destination connectors for CRM, ads, or support SaaS tools, nor any reverse-ETL activation workflow. Missing for 10: any mention of writing/syncing data out to Salesforce/HubSpot/ad platforms/support tools as destinations, and any reverse-ETL specific tooling or case studies.
